relationshipIdentifierDefault.description: Set the community's declared relationship-identifier default. See `CommunityProfile.relationshipIdentifierDefault` in the `vtc/_shared/0.1/community` schema. Omit to leave it unchanged.

personhood.description: Set the community's published personhood position. See `CommunityProfile.personhood` in the `vtc/_shared/0.1/community` schema. Replaces the whole object — a partial update would leave a verifier unable to tell an unset member from a cleared one. Omit to leave it unchanged.

Response.title: VTC Community Profile Update — response payload

profile.description: The community's profile as read, including the immutable `communityDid` an update cannot set.

fieldsChanged.description: Names of the profile members this update actually changed, in the wire spelling. Empty when the submitted values all matched what was already stored. Lets a caller distinguish a no-op from an applied change without diffing the returned profile against the one it sent.
